ai_summary_zh: 本場區包含總面積942.5平方公尺的鋪面道路與人行步道，路面狀況良好。場區內共有35株喬木，平均胸徑(DBH)為28.5公分，並設有總垂直面積687.6平方公尺的擋土牆與建築牆體。場區無水域，未發現任何水體或相關水文特徵。
ai_summary_en: The site features 942.5 m2 of paved roads and walkways in good condition. There are 35 urban trees with a mean DBH of 28.5 cm at 1.3m height, alongside 687.6 m2 of retaining and building wall structures. There are no water bodies on site, and no aquatic features were identified.
